objective: Complete fresh four-axis local verification of unchanged CAS11-C02 v3 forward implication, or return explicit mathematical/coverage/runtime blockers.
target: For all positive integers n, real symmetric PSD R in R^(n*n), e in R^n and epsilon>=0: [for all a in R^n, |a^T e|^2<=2*epsilon*a^T*R*a] implies e in range(R) and e^T*Rdagger*e<=2*epsilon.
excluded: C04 launch lifecycle repair or rerun

accounting.new_run_id: Choose one unique GRSTAT-CAS11-C02-<UTC timestamp> at first local intake, then reuse on continuation.
accounting.duplicate_rule: Inspect existing CAS11 work state before creating new launches. Preserve older evidence and never duplicate a live same-unit task.

lifecycle.stable_head: Resolve and record one safe primary-checkout BASE_HEAD after handoff intake and before new C02 registrations. Verify it before every dispatch. No commits/pulls/merges while this unit's launches depend on it.
lifecycle.source_binding: Seal new uncommitted axis source files by hashes at this BASE_HEAD. Their hashes complement but never silently replace the runtime's HEAD identity binding.
lifecycle.transport: Use currently supported transport/profile with actual enforced sandbox matching registration. Record requested versus observed model/effort separately; no implicit parent-profile inheritance.
lifecycle.finalize: After C02 author/reviewer jobs reach supported terminal states, stage only this unit's files and commit/non-force push. Do not carry a pending C02 launch across that HEAD change.
lifecycle.blocked_finalization: If a pending same-unit launch cannot be safely resolved with supported lifecycle, preserve outputs locally and return the precise publication blocker. Do not re-register, manually amend records or move HEAD to escape it.
lifecycle.c04_exemption: The unrelated preserved C04 launch is not modified or declared completed by C02. Respect any actual global policy block rather than bypassing it.

phases.goal: Resolve pinned starter, existing checkout changes, old C02 records and required source hashes.
phases.output: Input resolution and stable BASE_HEAD; missing input is an explicit blocker.

phases.goal: Resolve current authority; capture actual tool versions and pinned Lean environment before any result.
phases.output: New runtime observations; keep historical CAS_ENVIRONMENT and its timeout unchanged.

phases.goal: Fresh source-isolated authors for all four axes under one frozen contract. Separate output directories; no sibling or host proof reads.
phases.output: Own-axis sources, author/runtime/exposure records and declared coverage.

phases.goal: Freeze candidate source hashes, run own-axis alignment and meaningful failure controls, preserve all repair failures.
phases.output: Per-axis proof coverage including arbitrary n/rank; controls remain diagnostic.

phases.goal: Use existing run-adjudicate to execute all required axes from one observed parent process.
phases.output: Exact argv/cwd/timeouts/exits, complete child raw logs, runner stdout/stderr, ADJUDICATION.json.

phases.goal: One supported independent C02 review of exact contract, sealed sources, raw and coverage after authors finish.
phases.output: Actual findings and reviewer runtime or explicit blocker; no C04 launch reuse.

phases.goal: Preserve previous artifacts, validate return schema, finalize this unit's lifecycle, commit/non-force push only related files and R1.
phases.output: Immutable commit/tree handoff including next scientific dependency.

per_axis_required.argv: nonempty string array; unique across axes; actual axis-specific engine or wrapper

child_payload.stdout: one JSON document on completed scientific evaluation; all engine banners/full logs in separate captured files
child_payload.success: true only when the entire forward contract is covered under identical assumptions

runner_interface.incomplete_or_runtime_failure: Record actual engine status, coverage and errors; never synthesize a scientific false check for missing markers, crash or incomplete proof. Preserve nonzero exit and runner-derived raw status.
runner_interface.coverage_warning: The runner validates payload structure and execution. It does not independently prove mathematical coverage or source honesty. Raw aggregate and scope acceptance are separate.
runner_interface.full_logs_warning: Inspected runner retains tails; each wrapper must preserve complete engine stdout/stderr separately.
runner_interface.stored_adjudicate: Historical inspection only; never substitute for observed run-adjudicate.
